source_document_text:
ANSWER TO COMPLAINT
Plaintiff Avenholt Display Works LLC alleges that it sold and delivered 300 shelving units to defendant Pine Quay Merchandising, Inc. under a written agreement for $126,000, and seeks the unpaid balance of $46,000. Defendant Pine Quay Merchandising, Inc. admits that the parties entered into the agreement, that the units were delivered on May 2, 2024, and that it paid $80,000. Defendant admits that it has not paid the remaining $46,000, but denies that the full amount is due. Pine Quay alleges that 70 units were warped when delivered and that it notified Avenholt by email on May 15, 2024. Pine Quay further alleges that Avenholt inspected the units on May 20, 2024, but disputed the requested credit. Pine Quay claims a credit of $29,400 for the 70 units and states that, after that credit, no more than $16,600 remains payable. Pine Quay requests that the claim for the disputed amount be denied and that any judgment on the complaint be limited to $16,600.
